sector_scope: Brick-and-Mortar & E-Commerce Retail, Restaurants, Apparel/Footwear & Consumer Packaged Goods (SEC SIC major groups 20-21, 23, 284x, 3021, 314x, 52-59)

kpis.name_zh: 同店销售增速 (客流与客单价拆解)
kpis.definition_and_formula: Comparable store/system sales YoY % decomposed into Traffic (transactions) % and Average Ticket (ASP/basket) %
kpis.where_to_look: 8-K 99.1 Operational Highlights, MD&A Comps table & call Q&A
red_flags: Negative traffic masked only by pricing/ticket increases
Comps slowing sharply or turning negative across core banner

kpis.name_zh: 门店净增与单店经济模型
kpis.definition_and_formula: Net store openings/closures, digital/e-commerce mix %, sales per store or sq ft & new-store/franchise economics
kpis.where_to_look: MD&A Store Rollforward table, 10-K/10-Q Segment/Channel disclosures
red_flags: Store closures accelerating or impairment/lease-exit charges rising
E-commerce growth dilutive to store-level EBIT margin

kpis.name_en: Gross Margin: Pricing vs Promo & Shrink
kpis.name_zh: 毛利率拆解：提价 vs 促销与损耗
kpis.definition_and_formula: GM YoY bps bridge decomposing price/mix, markdown/promotional intensity, freight/input deflation & shrink
kpis.where_to_look: MD&A Gross Margin commentary & earnings call Q&A
red_flags: Gross margin down > 100bps due to promotional markdowns or elevated shrink
Volume elasticity weakening after cumulative price hikes

kpis.name_zh: 存货周转率与营运资本
kpis.definition_and_formula: Inventory Turnover = TTM COGS / Avg Inventory; DIO delta YoY; Inventory growth vs Revenue/COGS growth (pp gap)
red_flags: Inventory growth > COGS/Revenue growth by > 10-15pp ahead of soft comps
LIFO/markdown reserve buildup or extended DPO masking cash squeeze

filing_focus: Store Count Rollforward & Comparable Sales Definition (MD&A / 8-K 99.1)
Operating Lease Liabilities & Store Impairment Notes (R*.htm)

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Inventory overhang forcing next-quarter promotional markdowns
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: Inventory vs COGS growth > +15pp flag in earnings_quality_diagnostics + negative traffic comps
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q gross margin drops >= 75bps YoY or management guides higher markdowns

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Price-led comps masking volume/traffic erosion or store impairment risk
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: Traffic negative in MD&A/call while SG&A/store deleverages or sec_redline_diff cites impairment
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q comp traffic stays negative or net store openings are cut

unit_and_period_checks: 52-week vs 53-week fiscal calendar distortion explicitly adjusted
Comparable sales definition (e-commerce inclusion, store maturity threshold, constant FX) stated
Operating lease liabilities & store-opening CapEx distinguished from maintenance CapEx

reconciliation.metric: Total Revenue Growth vs Comps + Net Units
reconciliation.note: explain gap from new stores, 53rd week, FX, or wholesale/franchise mix
align FIFO/LIFO basis and freight capitalization

limits: Traffic vs ticket split and shrink bps are sometimes disclosed qualitatively only on calls
